text:
claire: Helix Compute sent their co-marketing bundle for the joint solution brief and hardware partner tile. Links: https://drive.company/helix/helix-bundle.zip and figma://helix/co-marketing

omar: quick check — do we have their vector badge? Helix requires color-on-dark and monochrome svgs.

viv: they only attached PNGs. requested svgs and the brand guide (Helix_Brand_2026.pdf). also flagged that their logo must appear smaller than Helix's per their spec.

legalbot: Uploaded partner agreement excerpt: we can use logos for marketing but must include the trademark line and not imply reseller status.

claire: copy ask — add footnote: "Hardware provided by Helix Compute; software and support by Redwood Inference." keep it subtle.

omar: design note — Helix insists on their blue gradient background; our marketplace hero must be white. I'll create two hero variants: white bg and Helix blue bleed.

viv: also there's a customer quote that references "50% throughput gain" — need permission to publish metrics. asked for signed permission.

legalbot: must get explicit metric consent. can't publish without the signed form.

designbot: Pushed frames to Figma: https://figma.com/file/helix/frames (frame 2 = white hero, frame 3 = co-branded hero). exported thumb_600x200 and tile_800x600.

claire: timeline — Helix wants tile live by next Friday. Marketing needs final assets by Wednesday EOD.

omar: I'll prepare the two lockups (side-by-side, stacked) and include alt text and accessibility notes.

viv: I'll follow up on SVGs and metric consent, will update thread when confirmed.

claire: thanks — once we have svgs + signed metric consent, legal will clear and marketing can publish.
